findings.violation: No text alternative is present and the element is not marked decorative.
findings.fix: Add an alt attribute (or aria-label) describing the image, or mark it decorative with alt="".

findings.location: "html > body > main > p:nth-of-type(2) > a", <a> link, text 'click here', line 21
findings.violation: The link's accessible name is a generic phrase that gives no clue to its destination out of context.
findings.fix: Rewrite the link text to describe its destination or purpose, or add an aria-label.

findings.location: "html > body > main > form > button", <button> control, visible label 'Submit', line 32
findings.evidence: visible text 'Submit', accessible name 'Send form now'
findings.violation: The control's visible text does not appear within its accessible name, so a voice-control user naming the visible label cannot activate it.
findings.fix: Include the visible label text at the start of the aria-label value, or remove the aria-label and rely on the visible text.

findings.location: "html > body > main > form > input:nth-of-type(2)", <input> control, line 30
findings.violation: No label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title identifies what this control expects.
findings.fix: Add a <label for> pointing at this control's id, wrap the control in a <label>, or set aria-label.

note: golden-01.html plants four single-occurrence defects: the crew photo carries no alt attribute and is not marked decorative (WCAG-1.1.1), the outage-history link's only text is the generic phrase click here (WCAG-2.4.4), the submit button's aria-label Send form now drops the visible word Submit so a voice-control user cannot activate it by the label they see (WCAG-2.5.3), and the phone input has no label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title of any kind (WCAG-3.3.2). Every other control in the form (the topic select and email input) is correctly labeled, and the page has a valid title, a well-formed lang attribute, and a main landmark, which is why none of those checks also fire. Each defect is a single instance, so all four sit at severity 2 per references/WCAG.md's anchor rows, and the gate passes because nothing reaches severity 3.
